description: Look up a real flight by number and date, then create it as a segment in the trip. Combines flight_quickadd_lookup + segment_create in one call. May take 2-5 seconds due to external flight data lookup. Segment dates must fall within the parent trip dates; use trip_update first to extend the trip.

airline.description: Full airline name as fallback (e.g., 'American Airlines'). Used only if airline_code is not provided.

airline_code.description: IATA or ICAO airline code (AA, UA, DL, AAL). Optional if embedded in flight_number.

flight_number.description: Flight number, e.g. 'AA3242', 'UA100', or just '3242' if airline_code is provided

trip_id.description: The trip ID to add the flight to

name: flight_quickadd
title: Add flight to trip
